hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template A(x)*B(x)^2 by substituting the parameter map for each member. For N0002 substitute A=G0, B=V, x=p; for N0006 substitute A=H0, B=W, x=q.
required_assumptions: Multiplication is treated as associative-commutative, so factor ordering is not significant
hypotheses.rationale: Both expressions have the same syntactic architecture: a unary function applied to a variable times the square of another unary function applied to the same variable. The observed relation is a substitution instance of this parameterized two-function kernel.
